description: This script manages platform-specific upgrade procedures for a system based on the Qualcomm IPQ95xx hardware. It includes functions for checking an image, performing upgrades, and copying configurations, with specific handling based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Stub function that always returns success, used for image validation.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade; calls different upgrade routines based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies platform-specific configuration; invoked for certain boards.
